The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
(Published by Authority)PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT

DEPARTMENT OF LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Uva Province
NOTICE OF FIRST MEETING OF THE COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66C (2) OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT INSTITUTIONS ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (262)

I, Dissanayaka Mudiyanselage Lalith Hemantha Dissanayaka, Commissioner of Local Government, Uva Province hereby give notice that under the powers vested in me under Section 66C (2) of the Local Government Institutions Elections Ordinance (262), as amended by the Local Government Institutions Elections (Amendment) Act, No. 22 of 2012, the first meeting of the Bandarawela Municipal Council in the Badulla District of Uva Province is Scheduled to be held on 11.06.2025 at 9.00 a. m. at the Council Chamber of Bandarawela Municipal Council.
D. M. L. H. Dissanayaka, Commissioner of Local Government.
Department of Local Government,Uva Province,02nd June, 2025.
